clips.title: The story
paras: At Lake Al'Ameth, Denalan studies Teldrassil's unusual plants and seeks remedies for its corruption. He tends a small lakeside plot and asks young adventurers to gather samples, examine timberlings, and test enchanted soil.

Denalan studies plants on Lake Al'Ameth's eastern shore. He works beneath a cloth awning, with field tools and rows of planter boxes close at hand. While many kaldorei focus on martial vigilance or high druidic rites, he gives his days to herbalism. He chooses this plot over Darnassus's grand barrows, so he can examine the unusual flora that has grown since the new World Tree was planted.

Denalan investigates the growing unrest among Teldrassil's native wildlife. Timberlings, usually docile woodland beings of wood and sprout, have grown increasingly aggressive. He enchants soil to nurture wild seeds in captivity and study how corruption seeps into root systems. Shimmering fronds, glowing fruit, and moss-twined growths are among the specimens he examines as he seeks the taint troubling the forest boughs.
